seo.title: Pricing | VoiceBridge
seo.description: VoiceBridge is free for families. See what's included, and the optional one-time fee for instant account approval.

hero.title: Simple, honest pricing
hero.intro: VoiceBridge's core features are free for every family. There's exactly one optional paid service — instant account approval.

free.title: Free
free.description: Everything a family needs to give their child a voice.
features: Personalised communication board with visual cards
free.note: New accounts are reviewed and approved by our team — this usually takes up to 24 hours.

instant.title: Instant Access
instant.description: Skip the review queue and start using VoiceBridge the moment you register.
features: Account approved automatically, right after payment
No waiting for manual admin review
instant.note: This fee also helps support VoiceBridge's ongoing development. See our Refunds & Cancellations policy for details.

items.question: Is VoiceBridge really free?
items.answer: Yes. Every core feature — the communication board, alerts, multiple profiles, and the mobile app — is free to use. The only paid option is a one-time ₹1,000 fee to skip manual account approval.

items.question: What happens if I don't pay the ₹1,000 fee?
items.answer: Nothing changes about the app itself — your account simply waits for an administrator to review and approve it, which typically happens within 24 hours.

items.question: Will there be paid subscriptions in future?
items.answer: We may introduce optional premium features for therapy centers in the future. If we do, pricing and terms will be clearly listed here before launch.
